generated.details: At middle-left beside the laptop, the watercolor palette is a shallow white ceramic tray with recessed pigment wells and a broader mixing recess bearing dried washes.
At middle-right on the tabletop, the geometric foam mock-up pieces are small cream blocks and wedges with flat cut faces and subtly porous edges resting securely on their bases.
At far right behind the table, the fabric-roll rack has braced metal uprights supporting horizontal rods through the cores of plain cream fabric rolls.

Beside it toward center, the large abstract canvas leans against the rear wall, its painted fabric stretched around a wooden frame, showing only nonfigurative shapes without text, faces or characters.
